title: Weight and Body Composition Trend
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings measurements (`withings:measure`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export or Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=withings:measure
| timechart span=1w avg(weight_kg) as weight, avg(fat_pct) as body_fat
| eventstats avg(weight) as avg_weight
description: Smooths your smart-scale readings into a weekly trend so day-to-day water-weight noise stops hiding the real direction of travel.
value: Daily weigh-ins are noisy and demoralising; a weekly average shows the genuine trend and keeps you focused on progress, not fluctuations.
implementation: Ingest Withings or other smart-scale data; schedule weekly and review the smoothed weight line rather than single readings.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average weight and body-fat percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It averages your scale readings each week so the normal ups and downs do not distract you from the real trend.
